data.title: 加藤惠 · 社团电脑前的无声吐槽·「伦也君……这个剧情是不是太奇怪了」
data.description: 【丰之崎学园游戏制作室·放学后】放学后的社团活动室，惠坐在电脑桌边测试试玩版本，一只手托腮，另一只手握鼠标。屏幕上的奇葩剧情让她微微眯眼，嘴角挂着若有若无的平静吐槽，制服外披着红色开衫。
data.action: 单手托腮握鼠标测试游戏，眯眼露出一丝平静吐槽
data.lighting: 屏幕荧光与窗外橙黄晚霞交错
data.camera: medium shot, seated at desk, hand on cheek, monitor glow
data.promptProse: Megumi Kato sits at a computer desk inside the after-school game development clubroom, wearing her navy sailor uniform under an unbuttoned cherry-red cardigan. Playtesting a rough demo, she rests her cheek against one palm while holding the mouse, her soft brown eyes narrowing into an adorable deadpan squint at the bizarre dialogue on screen. The soft glow of the monitor illuminates her calm, understated expression amidst stacks of scenario scripts. Medium shot, warm late-afternoon twilight mixing with screen light, detailed clubroom background, solo 1girl, no extra people.
